what: Simpler team dashboard: a plain overview with today's schedule and open decisions, a new How it works page with pictures, and every update on its own page
why: So everyone, including teammates who don't read code, can see at a glance what we're building, what happens today, who owns what, and what is working, in progress or only planned.
details: Overview: one sentence on the demo, the countdown to 3 PM, the Sunday run of day (every item 'Proposed' except the 3 PM demo), six open decisions for the 9 AM standup, one plain card per track with owner and next step, and the latest updates. How it works (design.html, words in dashboard/data/design.json so anyone can edit them): the demo in five steps with the taped-mark backup and the e-stop operator, the whole system, the machines and their owners, and a glossary; every box says working, in progress or planned. The full feed, charts and filters moved to updates.html. Track changes: arm station owner FADI and Dream AI owner Denys, as docs/plan.md names them; can hand-off milestones replace the Portal-era ones; sdk-pickup is done per the 2026-11-07 18:35 update; no other milestone was marked done. To change the schedule or decisions, edit dashboard/data/project.json; build.py --check validates it.
